::: {#exr-pois-score-fn}
#### Score function of a Poisson variable

Derive the score function for a single Poisson random variable $X$,
with respect to its mean parameter $\rate$.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-pois-score-fn}

The log-likelihood of one Poisson observation is
$\loglik = x \logf{\rate} - \rate - \logf{x!}$, so:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\score
&\eqdef \deriv{\rate}\loglik
&& \text{(definition of the score)}\\
&= \deriv{\rate}\paren{x\logf{\rate} - \rate - \logf{x!}}
&& \text{(Poisson log-likelihood)}\\
&= \deriv{\rate}\paren{x\logf{\rate}} - \deriv{\rate}\rate - \deriv{\rate}\logf{x!}
&& \text{(linearity of differentiation)}\\
&= \deriv{\rate}\paren{x\logf{\rate}} - \deriv{\rate}\rate - 0
&& \text{(derivative of a constant)}\\
&= \deriv{\rate}\paren{x\logf{\rate}} - \deriv{\rate}\rate
&& \text{(drop the zero term)}\\
&= x\deriv{\rate}\logf{\rate} - \deriv{\rate}\rate
&& \text{(constant multiple rule)}\\
&= x\rate^{-1} - \deriv{\rate}\rate
&& \text{(derivative of $\log \rate$)}\\
&= x\rate^{-1} - 1
&& \text{(derivative of $\rate$ with respect to itself)}\\
&= \frac{x}{\rate} - 1
&& \text{(write the negative power as a fraction)}\\
&= \frac{x}{\rate} - \frac{\rate}{\rate}
&& \text{(write both terms over the common denominator)}\\
&= \frac{x - \rate}{\rate}
&& \text{(combine the fractions)}\\
&= \frac{x - \E{X}}{\rate}
&& \text{($\E{X} = \rate$)}\\
&= \frac{x - \E{X}}{\Var{X}}
&& \text{($\Var{X} = \rate$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
